diagnostics.arithmetic_repair: triggered_only; exact frozen matrices; no saturation substitution

frequency_map.parameter_grid: all 2880 accepted actual HS-B angles in angles_deg; addressed model roots and derivative checks only
frequency_map.policy_override_reason: unchanged HS-D1 p20/24 and model-specific endpoint counts; no global strict audit

reuse_rules.full: exact geometry, material, spring, beta and normalization from accepted HS-B; no new full solves
reuse_rules.L1: exact kind, k_joint, mu, tau and frozen model/numerics; epsilon/aspect act only in mapping and frequency scaling
reuse_rules.C_II_III: exact k_joint, mu, beta, RIGID trace and frozen model/numerics; epsilon and aspect absent from this dimensionless problem
reuse_rules.C_I: exact k_joint, mu, beta, kappa_s and frozen model/numerics
reuse_rules.case_identity: always retain epsilon, aspect, chi and original geometry ID alongside the reusable dimensionless point key
reuse_rules.missing_evidence: frequency-only prior records do not replace the required normalized shapes, per-mode D and physical checks

statistics.weighting: unweighted actual archived nodes, including root iterations

full_threshold_source: thresholds.json (omega90), cross-checked against thresholds.csv and predictions.csv
